newsitem.title: UGANDA: Fifth grenade blast in Kampala, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Fifth grenade blast in Kampala, no casualties.

text.p: A hand grenade exploded on the outskirts of the Ugandan capital Kampala on Tuesday but there were no casualties, the state New Vision newspaper reported on Wednesday.
In the fifth grenade blast since they began last week, the grenade exploded at a road junction on the outskirts of Kampala. Police blamed "hard core criminals" and vowed to arrest the attackers.
A total of nine people were killed and 70 wounded in grenade explosions in Kampala last week. President Yoweri Museveni blamed a rebel group, the Allied Democratic Forces, active in western Uganda.
